Talent0_2Ability.name: 凝势星爆
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击时，每命中<color=#F74848>1</color>个目标，战后获得<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>，可叠加<color=#F74848>5</color>层；主动攻击后，若携带<color=#F74848>5</color>层及以上<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>，立刻移除<color=#F74848>5</color>层<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>，获得<color=#F74848>3</color>AP及对应的<buf ID=900138>[临时AP上限]</buf>，并发动<buf ID=900005>[再行动]</buf>，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次

Talent3_5Ability.name: 凝势星爆
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
主动攻击时，每命中<color=#F74848>1</color>个目标，战后获得<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>，可叠加<color=#F74848>5</color>层；主动攻击后，若携带<color=#F74848>5</color>层及以上<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>，立刻移除<color=#F74848>5</color>层<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>，获得<color=#F74848>3</color>AP及对应的<buf ID=900138>[临时AP上限]</buf>，并发动<buf ID=900005>[再行动]</buf>，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次；
出击时，获得<color=#F74848>2</color>层<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>；行动开始时，若上次行动触发过<buf ID=900133>[凝势]</buf>的AP回复效果后，则额外回复<color=#F74848>1</color>AP

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101702.name: 碎钢
101702.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击时，对耐久值高于等于<color=#F74848>50%</color>的部位伤害提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>

101703.name: 镜心
101703.SpecificEffects: 遭受格斗或射击武器攻击对战时，若装备两把刀剑且双手完好，发动<buf ID=900136>[看破]</buf>，造成<color=#F74848>1.2</color>倍伤害，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次

101704.name: 星坠闪
101704.describe: 选择周围<color=#F74848>4</color>格内<color=#F74848>1</color>名目标（包括飞行目标），目标周围<color=#F74848>1</color>圈可以停留，使用刀剑对目标造成<color=#F74848>1.2</color>倍伤害，攻击前可<buf ID=900014>[瞄准]</buf>，命中目标后停留在目标周围<color=#F74848>1</color>圈随机空地上

101705.name: 复辉
101705.SpecificEffects: 任意手臂损毁时，战后将修复最多<color=#F74848>1</color>只手臂<color=#F74848>50%</color>耐久值，间隔<color=#F74848>3</color>回合后可再次发动

101706.name: 崩穹斩
101706.describe: 使用两把刀剑攻击面前<range type=2>横向3格</range>或斜向折角<color=#F74848>3</color>格范围内的所有目标，攻击前可对所有目标分别进行<buf ID=900014>[瞄准]</buf>，造成<color=#F74848>1.5</color>倍范围伤害

101707.name: 破势
101707.SpecificEffects: 行动开始时，若周围<color=#F74848>3</color>格内存在<color=#F74848>3</color>台及以上敌机，获得<color=#F74848>2</color>层<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>

101708.name: 辉断终焉
101708.describe: 使用两把刀剑攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>2.4</color>倍伤害，必定攻击躯干，并获得<color=#F74848>2</color>层<buf ID=1017503>[凝势Ⅰ]</buf>

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101531.name: 终结者1
101531.SpecificEffects: 使用刀剑主动攻击后，如果命中的部位耐久值低于<color=#F74848>15%</color>，发动<buf ID=900109>[处决]</buf>效果，战后直接破坏该部位

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

101534.name: 终结者2
101534.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1015311>[终结者1]</buf>破坏部位的临界线提升至<color=#F74848>25%</color>

101535.name: 终结者3
101535.SpecificEffects: 发动<buf ID=900101>[终结者]</buf>破坏部位时，抵消<color=#F74848>1</color>次<buf ID=900004>[再攻击]</buf>或<buf ID=900005>[再行动]</buf>的次数扣除并额外回复<color=#F74848>1</color>AP，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次

101536.name: 终结者4
101536.SpecificEffects: 使用刀剑击破躯干以外的部位时，对躯干造成相当于该部位最大耐久值<color=#F74848>25%</color>的<buf ID=900017>[固定伤害]</buf>

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101746.name: 双生星芒4
101746.SpecificEffects: 天赋效果提升为回复<color=#F74848>5</color>AP，并额外获得<buf ID=1017466>[星爆]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合
